name: How much does drywall patching cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does drywall patching cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of drywall patching in the Bay Area varies based on several factors, including the extent of the damage, the size of the area to be patched, and the specific materials required. Minor repairs might range from $150 to $300, while more extensive damage involving larger sections or multiple repairs could be $400 or more. These are estimates; we provide a detailed quote after assessing your specific needs. Factors like accessibility and the need for specific textures also influence the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall patching costs in the Bay Area depend on the damage size and complexity. Minor repairs may range from $150-$300, while larger jobs could be $400 or more.
